notes.title: THANK YOU FOR 60,000 WISHLISTS + WHO I AM
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I'm Geraldo Mendes, but you can call me Mendesz, the solo developer behind Tempus Triad.
I want to start by sincerely thanking you: over 60,000 people have already added the game to their wishlists.
Honestly, I never imagined reaching this point, especially with my first game. It truly surprised me and motivates me even more to do my best.

Since I was a kid, playing titles like Silent Hill and Dino Crisis, I always dreamed of creating an intense experience — the kind of horror that makes you feel lost, hunted, unsure of what is real or imaginary.
And something I always felt was missing in games was seeing dinosaurs in a truly heavy, terrifying atmosphere. Not just as action monsters, but as imposing, ancient creatures carrying a primal fear.
Tempus Triad is my attempt to bring that side of dinosaurs back — more terrifying, darker, and more impactful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45017118/65b59207be943c647a77d275e3140c922c4f2b33.jpg[/img]

I also want to thank you for all the feedback you have given so far — there have been more than 600 reviews for the demo, and I’ve read every single one.
It’s been a huge help to improve the game and shows me that all this effort is truly worth it.

The full release is getting closer. I hope you get as many chills playing it as I do creating it.

Thank you so much for being part of this journey with me.
If you’d like to leave your thoughts, I'm always reading everything on the forums!

With gratitude,
Mendesz
